# Setup



```{r}
library(reticulate)

# Import Python modules into R variables
#py_install(c("xarray", "netcdf4", "scipy")) 
xr   <- import("xarray")
np   <- import("numpy")
pd   <- import("pandas")
time <- import("time")
```


```{r}
# assign months, latitudes, and depths to filter
# all are integers, depths are in meters
# filters are inclusive (closed interval), e.g. depth 0-180 includes depths 0 and 180 and every depth between

lifestage_dict <- list(
  spawn = list( # spawn
    min_month = 1,
    max_month = 3,
    min_lat   = 31,
    max_lat   = 36,
    min_depth = 130,
    max_depth = 500
  ), #long extent shelf break
  egg = list( # egg
    min_month = 1,
    max_month = 3,
    min_lat   = 40,
    max_lat   = 60,
    min_depth = 40,
    max_depth = 60
  ), #long extent shelf break
  yolk = list( # yolk
    min_month = 1,
    max_month = 4,
    min_lat   = 31,
    max_lat   = 36,
    min_depth = 50, 
    max_depth = 100 
  ), #long extent shelf break
  JAc = list( # JAc
    min_month = 1,
    max_month = 4,
    min_lat   = 34.5,
    max_lat   = 42.5,
    min_depth = 30,
    max_depth = 130
  ),
  latelarv = list( # latelarv
    min_month = 3,
    max_month = 6,
    min_lat   = 31,
    max_lat   = 37,
    min_depth = 50,
    max_depth = 300
  ),
  late = list( # late
    min_month = 3,
    max_month = 6,
    min_lat   = 33.5,
    max_lat   = 34.5,
    min_depth = 75,
    max_depth = 275
  )
)

```
